gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Standard Salesforce objects prioritized Standard Salesforce objects are prioritized over custom objects for the new implementation, defaulting to native features whenever possible. [listed under Decisions: ALIGNED]; also Summary: 'A decision was made to prioritize standard functionality over custom designs.'
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Waleed Alasadi: Okay. Me and I are split, so we don't have a hard opinion yet, / Waleed Alasadi: we don't think that you should use custom objects. Um but we're like we're going to determine throughout the process. Okay.
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary marks this as an aligned decision; transcript shows a Jumpr stance with no hard opinion yet, to be determined during discovery, and no client confirmation.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Partners and Operators as Accounts Partners and Operators are to be implemented as standard Salesforce Account objects to enable effective contact relationship tracking. [Decisions: ALIGNED]; Details: 'The consultants also determined that "Partners" and "Operators" should be treated as Accounts'
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Waleed Alasadi: accounts like full-on like accounts and we'll use them simply because you have to use um the contacts under there. / Joyce Kiddell: Mhm. / Waleed Alasadi: Um, so that's like one answer on native that we'll kind of look into.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: External file linking strategy adopted The file storage strategy will prioritize saving links to external files (e.g., Dropbox, Drive) instead of uploading raw files to Salesforce to optimize storage costs.
